title: Flow Duplicate Io Channel Labels
description: Input/output channel names appear twice in the flow editor because port labels are painted both via Vello (paint_port_labels) and the JS Canvas 2D overlay (port_label_overlay_rows). Skip Vello port label painting when delegated to the JS overlay.
summary: Fixed duplicate slider names (and tightened hover-ghost caption painting). Slider labels were serialized into the JS canvas overlay but Vello still called `paint_slider_name`. Slider and computation node captions now skip Vello painting when `node_caption_delegated_to_js_overlay` is true, matching io widgets and port labels.
